test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We saw some children _______ with one another as we were walking around.
solution:
The correct answer is- 'quarrelling.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the given sentence the verb '*quarrelling*' is the correct choice to fill.
 
• In the given sentence the verb **quarrel **is used as a **gerund **(*verb + ing*) and not as a **verb**.
 
• we can also understand it as the word **quarrelling **is not followed by a helping verb, so it is **not **acting as a **verb **here.
 
• Thus *option 2 *is the correct answer.

The correct sentence is: *We saw some children **quarrelling** with one another as we were walking around.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's learn about the conjunction as:

 
 
• We use the *conjunction ***as **when one event happens while another is in progress (‘*during the time that*’). In this case, the **verb **after is often in the **continuous **form: 

 
 
• Example: 

 
 
• *They arrived **as **we were leaving.*
